pairs.gold_text: Grennet Power revised its policy during the later response.
pairs.system_text: Grennet Power revised its policy at the end of the window.

pairs.gold_text: The warning period caused deaths during the Verlow heatwave.
pairs.system_text: The heatwave was confirmed to have caused deaths in Verlow.

unmatched_system.text: Officials attributed deaths to the warning period itself, with mortality assessed against the period of the alert.

pairs.gold_text: Injuries were confirmed in Verlow during the Verlow heatwave.
pairs.system_text: Injuries were confirmed and documented in the town on the day the substation failed.

pairs.gold_text: Damage associated with Verlow Tramways was reported during the Verlow heatwave.
pairs.system_text: Verlow Tramways was reported to have caused damage in the town at the end of the window.

pairs.gold_text: Marnest substation was destroyed during the Verlow heatwave.
Service at Verlow General Hospital was disrupted during the Verlow heatwave.
pairs.system_text: Service at Verlow General Hospital was disrupted during the load-shedding period.

pairs.gold_text: People were displaced from Verlow during evacuation and displacement operations.
pairs.system_text: People moved away from Verlow as a result of displacement during the heatwave.

pairs.gold_text: Dangerous conditions were present at Hetton Rise and Camber Green during the Verlow heatwave.
pairs.system_text: Dangerous conditions were present at Hetton Rise and Camber Green at the end of the window.

unmatched_gold.text: Assistance was provided in Hetton Rise as response operations continued.

pairs.gold_text: Grennet Power deployed as response operations continued.
pairs.system_text: Grennet Power, the network operator, deployed two days later as load-shedding began.

pairs.gold_text: Provincial Public Health Institute deployed as response operations continued.
pairs.system_text: The Provincial Public Health Institute deployed to Verlow at the start of the heatwave.

unmatched_system.text: Grennet Power and the institute deployed again to Hetton Rise and the tower blocks at the end of the window.

pairs.gold_text: The institute asked for assistance concerning Verlow during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: The institute asked for assistance concerning Verlow.

pairs.gold_text: Grennet Power issued a warning during emergency communications.
pairs.system_text: Grennet Power issued a load-shedding warning for Verlow two days later.

unmatched_system.text: The Provincial Public Health Institute issued a heat warning for Verlow.
The institute issued a further warning after deaths were reported.
Assistance was provided in Hetton Rise and the tower blocks.

unmatched_gold.text: Assistance was received in Hetton Rise during relief operations.
